[[Villnar's Claw]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[wand]] dropped by [[Villnar Painforge]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Sorrow's Furnace]].

==Stats==
:[[Cold damage]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Curses]])
:[[Energy]] +5 (while [[Hex]]ed)
:Halves casting time of [[Curses]] [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Boneclaw Rod]].

==Replica==
This item cannot be replicated, as it effectively has two [[inscription]]s, (non-max) "I Am Sorrow" and "Aptitude not Attitude".
